entities.summary: Tim Vanhamel (b. 1977-12-11, Zonhoven) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zonhoven and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, composers & musicians, europe.
